styles.style: Refined travel-journal editorial illustration. Deep forest green #075747 uniform fine-but-legible rounded outline strokes, pale sage, muted sand and pale water-blue accents on warm ivory #FBFAF5. Icons must be clean precise geometric outlines with a small amount of soft flat fill, NOT scratchy hand scribbles. Illustrations can use delicate ink contours and a restrained pale watercolor wash with lots of whitespace. Calm, thoughtful, mature; inspired by the supplied screen concept art.

styles.name: やさしいフラット
styles.description: 丸い輪郭と控えめな色面。小さな操作アイコンも見分けやすい方向。
styles.style: Friendly contemporary flat illustration system. Bold rounded geometric silhouettes with disciplined moderate line width, deep forest green #075747 primary, sage #AACBB9, warm amber #E4B56E and muted sky-blue #91BCCB accents, warm ivory background #FBFAF5. Two or three solid colors per icon, slightly softer corners and fuller shapes than standard outline icons. No gradients, no shadows, no cartoon faces in controls. Warm, inviting and highly legible; consistent with LocalVoice's green identity.

styles.name: 小さな立体
styles.description: 深緑・ミント・アイボリーの小さな立体。挿絵に存在感を持たせる方向。
styles.style: Restrained premium soft-dimensional illustration system. Very simple rounded matte clay/paper objects, shallow 2.5D relief depth, gentle top-left studio lighting and small soft shadows; NOT shiny glossy plastic, NOT photorealism, NOT complex isometric environments. Deep forest green #075747, soft mint, ivory and one muted amber/blue accent on warm ivory #FBFAF5. Controls must keep absolutely conventional recognizable front-facing silhouettes and generous simple negative space. Mature playful touch, coherent objects and consistent view angle.
